name: bipeur
description: Relays Kiro Crew approval events to a Beeper pager and resolves each approval from the human's signed decision.

pages.title: Beeper
pages.description: Pending Crew approvals and the pager screen, inside the Crew dashboard.

outbound.purpose: resolve a Crew approval from the decision taken on the pager
write a notice in the Crew journal of record

CREW_GATEWAY_URL.description: Crew Gateway base URL, ws(s) or http(s). Exact value to verify (A.9).

CREW_APPROVAL_PATH.description: POST path that resolves an approval. Exact path to verify (A.9).

CREW_NOTIFICATION_PATH.description: POST path that posts a notification. Exact path to verify (A.9).

BIPEUR_TOKEN.description: Station token of the Central. Required.

BIPEUR_STATION.description: Station alias shown on the page line.
